description: Twelve Fizzera functional-soda competitive-intelligence task designs for paired V1/V2 evaluation. All are unverified DRAFTS; no competitor reference facts or citations are asserted. Historical evidence ends 2026-10-09, with Fizzera context dated 2026-10-16. Requires human curation and a new verified release before execution. Generic ci_draft_v1.json is retained as an unchanged archive.

tasks.question: Using only the supplied frozen sources published from 2024-10-10 through 2026-10-09, identify one distinct soda product launch or relaunch reported for Olipop and one for Poppi. For each, give product/flavor, publication and announcement or launch date, stated market and retailer/channel, and whether availability is announced or demonstrated. Cite exact passages. State any missing brand coverage rather than substituting an unrelated brand, and give one brief, conditional relevance statement for Fizzera's 2027 product decision using the supplied brief.

expected_components.requirement: Identify one supported launch/relaunch per named brand, or explicitly report the missing brand evidence; do not treat syndicated coverage as a distinct launch.
Record product/flavor, publication date, stated event date, market, channel and announcement-versus-availability status with exact source citations.
Explain one conditional Fizzera relevance statement grounded in cited brief pages; do not infer demand, sales success or a preferred launch from announcement alone.

allowed_source_types: dated beverage-trade article with readable launch passages
known_challenges: Research objective: Retrieve dated competitor product launches and separate announcements from availability.
Fizzera context: pp. 2-5, 11-12: taste-first accessible positioning, current portfolio and one 2027 launch; no concept approved.
Curation required: Existing five-body pilot contains Olipop launch reporting, not a Poppi body. Curate a qualifying Poppi source; verify product, dates, market and attribution before creating a key.
Scoring: apply independent-human-v1 rubric to verified components, source support, attribution, chronology, geography and appropriate abstention; runtime Reviewer verdict is not ground truth.
Draft only: no reference facts, citations, verification attestation or input snapshot is supplied. Difficulty requires empirical calibration.
